subject: Food Truck Licensing Ordinance Reform
overview: The committee met to discuss an ordinance that would delegate the approval of one-day and special event food truck licenses to administrative departments. The matter was kept in committee to allow for a redrafting of the regulations to clarify jurisdictional authority over public ways and city-owned property.

items.title: Food Truck Ordinance (Item 20-020)
items.summary: Kept the ordinance in committee for redrafting with legal counsel to clarify jurisdictional authority and streamline the issuance of one-day food truck permits. Members debated the scope of City Council control over public ways compared to other city properties and the need to protect brick-and-mortar businesses while simplifying the administrative process for event vendors.
